name: Pinegap
description: Power your equity research with earnings previews, post-earnings recaps, management guidance, KPI tables, comp sheets, risks, read-throughs, and AI-generated thesis synthesis. Pinegap provides 40+ institutional analyst tools — drawing AI-powered deep equity research across earnings, company research, watchlists, agents, and investment thesis tracking.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pinegap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pinegap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pinegap.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pinegap MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pinegap lists 36 MCP tools, including capital-allocation, company-profile, competitive-landscape, conference-recap, conference-takeaways, earnings-preview, earnings-price-reactions, earnings-recap, earnings-takeaway, executive-bios, fetch-document, and guidance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pinegap?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pinegap in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Pinegap requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
